scope: All ten configurations and 108 planned positions; no refits or timing replacements. Numerical columns report maxima over completed repetitions relative to the same-core native reference. Native repeats reuse certified exact capture/RSS evidence.

configurations.comparison: Existing captures only; no refitting or gate changes. Differences use the same-core first native repetition as reference, not a full-panel exact oracle. Later native repetitions reuse its diagnostics only after exact capture/RSS agreement is verified.

definitions.model_score: Maximum absolute residual moment over worker levels, firm levels and controls, divided by max(1, corresponding sum of abs(y)+abs(fitted)).
definitions.centered_fe: Each level effect minus its observation-weighted channel mean; FE error quantiles/RMSE give each level equal weight unless marked observation_weighted.
definitions.output_errors: Absolute errors in log daily wage units, relative to the native saved outputs.
